parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity or expression; same-sex conduct legal since 2007; progressive supreme court rulings, pride events, curriculum inclusion and community infrastructure are documented positives. Visitor documents come from home country, so lagging domestic marker-change rules are climate signals only. Weighing against: documented frequent physical and sexual harassment of visibly trans people in public spaces (Nov 2024), deep-rooted stigma, discrimination in government institutions, thin practical recourse, and escalating political hate speech plus death threats from the head of government's supporters (April 2026). Worst features sit at tier 3 (societal/political hostility), not tier 1 — no state-imposed facility, custody or document exposure for visitors is documented. No trans-specific killing data exists either way.
